sloka: दुरात्मन्नात्मनाशाय केशपक्षे परामृशः।ब्रह्मर्षीणां कुले जातो राक्षसीं योनिमाश्रितः ।। ६.८१.१९ ।।
transliteration: durātmannātmanāśāya keśapakṣe parāmṛśaḥ।brahmarṣīṇāṁ kule jāto rākṣasīṁ yonimāśritaḥ ।। 6.81.19 ।।

translations.english: "You are ignoble, mean, of sinful prowess, not merciful. You have resolved to take such a sinful action which is not worthy of you. You have no compassion to act in this manner."
